name: Static-site generator "CMS" with dynamic booking content

mentions.name: Static-site generator "CMS" with dynamic booking content
mentions.description: A static-site generator "CMS" that the author is open-sourcing and extending to add dynamic content, such as a reservation/booking tool, to what is essentially a statically hosted web page.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm in the progress of open-sourcing (and extending) my static-site generator "CMS" (with big air-quotes).

The idea is to add dynamic content, i.e. reservation tool, to what is essentially a statically hosted web page.

Demo: https://astro-booking.pages.dev/booking/
